No storm is forecast for the Central PA hubs through Oct 21, 2026. The only active alert is a minor Coastal Flood Advisory on the Jersey Shore, which includes Ocean County, where Horvath operates (National Weather Service alerts).

The NJ advisory

  • Type: Coastal Flood Advisory. Severity is "Minor," urgency "Expected," certainty "Likely" (National Weather Service alerts).
  • Timing: It was issued at 4:02 AM EDT on Oct 19. Onset is 3:00 PM EDT on Oct 20, and it runs until 9:00 PM EDT on Oct 20 (National Weather Service alerts).
  • Area: Ocean, Atlantic, Cape May, and southeastern Burlington coastal zones (National Weather Service alerts).
  • Elsewhere: PA, MA, CT, RI, NH, ME and VT have zero alerts (National Weather Service alerts).

Central PA forecast

The forecast is dry and calm. Every hub shown has 0.0 in. of rain and a 0% chance of precipitation from Oct 18 to Oct 21 (Open-Meteo 7-day forecast).
